# waroom_service_webhook_configuration (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom webhook configuration of a service. Look it up by `uuid` or by `name`; exactly one of them must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a webhook configuration by name
data "waroom_service_webhook_configuration" "by_name" {
  service_name = "my-service"
  name         = "my-webhook"
}

# Look up a webhook configuration by UUID
data "waroom_service_webhook_configuration" "by_uuid" {
  service_name = "my-service"
  uuid         = "7dcf90f0-de30-4bd3-a797-3d53cef7ec7d"
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value = data.waroom_service_webhook_configuration.by_name.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_name` (String) The name of the Waroom service the webhook configuration belongs to.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the webhook configuration to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` and `name` must be set. It is an error if more than one webhook configuration in the service has this name.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the webhook configuration to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the webhook configuration was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Webhook configuration ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `state` (String) The state of the webhook configuration: `unverified`, `verified` or `archived`.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the webhook configuration was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
- `url` (String) The URL that webhook events are sent to.
- `webhook_subscription_events` (Attributes List) The events the webhook configuration subscribes to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook_subscription_events))

<a id="nestedatt--webhook_subscription_events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook_subscription_events`

Read-Only:

- `event_type` (String) The event type, e.g. `incident_created`, `incident_updated`, `runbook_executed`, `runbook_skipped`, `incident_slack_channel_created` or `test_ping`.
- `event_version` (String) The version of the event payload, e.g. `v1`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the subscription.
